meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成“调度员”：不自己写代码，而是把工作计划拆成小任务，派给多个后台子代理并行执行；它持续跟踪进度、记录证据，直到计划全部完成，并以提交或PR形式交付。即使中途停下，也会在下回合自动接续。
howto.when: 在完成规划后，你说出“start work”“execute plan”“continue plan”等指令，或要求运行 .omo/plans 计划时触发。

say.text: 开始工作，执行 .omo/plans 里的计划
say.note: Claude 会找到计划并开始派发子代理执行。
接着上次未完成的检查项继续推进。

say.text: 按 .omo/plans 里的计划执行，用 PR 交付
say.note: 会创建分支并在完成后提交拉取请求。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it never writes code itself, instead splitting the plan into small tasks for parallel background subagents. It tracks progress and evidence until the plan is done, and resumes automatically if interrupted mid-way.
howto.when_en: After planning, it triggers when you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", etc., or ask to run a .omo/plans plan.

say_en.text: Start work and execute the plan under .omo/plans.
say_en.note: Claude will pick the plan and begin dispatching subagents.
It resumes from the last unchecked item.

say_en.text: Run the .omo/plans plan and deliver via a PR.
say_en.note: It creates a branch, opens a PR when done.
